summary.fr: Sur le patch 16.22, Lee Sin support affiche 42,6 % de victoires sur 967 parties classées (Émeraude+), tier B. Il souffre surtout contre Leona, Thresh et Lulu.
summary.en: On patch 16.22, Lee Sin support has a 42.6% win rate over 967 ranked games (Emerald+), B tier. It struggles most against Leona, Thresh and Lulu.
